data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Allias', which means 'other' or 'different' in origin. In Greek mythology, Allias was an epithet of the goddess Athena, representing her protective and guardian role. In Christianity, 'Allista' can be interpreted as 'God's pledge' or 'divine commitment'.
